Cleaning after AQ factor scores are computed

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(psych)
```


```{r}
data_FU2 = read.csv("survey content FU2.csv")
AQ_scores_FU2 = read.csv("AQ imputed FU2.csv")
```


original AQ scores, again, these are referring to the AQ factors found in Zhu et al., (2022)

```{r}
original_AQ_social_discourse_FU2 = AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._1:AQ._3) %>% rowMeans(na.rm = T)
original_AQ_pattern_FU2 = AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._8:AQ._12) %>% rowMeans(na.rm=T)
original_AQ_imagination_FU2 = AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._14:AQ._18) %>% rowMeans(na.rm=T)
original_AQ_social_cognition_FU2 = AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._21:AQ._25) %>% rowMeans(na.rm=T)
original_AQ_social_anhedonia_FU2 = AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._29:AQ._34) %>% rowMeans(na.rm=T)

original_AQ_scores_FU2 = data.frame(ID = AQ_scores_FU2$ID, original_AQ_social_anhedonia_FU2,original_AQ_pattern_FU2,original_AQ_social_cognition_FU2, original_AQ_social_discourse_FU2, original_AQ_imagination_FU2)


AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._1:AQ._3) %>% psych::alpha()
AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._8:AQ._12) %>% psych::alpha()
AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._14:AQ._18) %>% psych::alpha()
AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._21:AQ._25) %>% psych::alpha()
AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._29:AQ._34) %>% psych::alpha()


```

New AQ scores. Remember, 6 items were dropped from the FU1. New AQ scores include all AQ items administered in FU2.

```{r}
new_AQ_social_discourse_FU2 = AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._1:AQ._7) %>% rowMeans(na.rm = T) 
new_AQ_pattern_FU2 = AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._8:AQ._13) %>% rowMeans(na.rm = T) 
new_AQ_imagination_FU2 = AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._14:AQ._20) %>% rowMeans(na.rm = T) 
new_AQ_social_cogition_FU2 = AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._21:AQ._28) %>% rowMeans(na.rm = T) 
new_AQ_social_anhedonia_FU2 = AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._29:AQ._34) %>% rowMeans(na.rm = T)



new_AQ_scores_FU2 = data.frame(ID = AQ_scores_FU2$ID,new_AQ_social_anhedonia_FU2, new_AQ_pattern_FU2, new_AQ_social_cogition_FU2, new_AQ_social_discourse_FU2,new_AQ_imagination_FU2)

AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._1:AQ._7) %>% psych::alpha()
AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._8:AQ._13) %>% psych::alpha()
AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._14:AQ._20) %>% psych::alpha()
AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._21:AQ._28) %>% psych::alpha()
AQ_scores_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(AQ._29:AQ._34) %>% psych::alpha()

```



Calculate MSS Disorganized Schizotypy Subscale scores

```{r}
data_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("MSS")) %>% psych::alpha()
```

Calculate WSS subscale scores

```{r}
data_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("WSS")) %>% psych::alpha()
WSS_survey_FU2 = data_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("WSS"))
```

```{r}
magical_ideation_scale_FU2 =  WSS_survey_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(WSS_1:WSS_15)

wss_magical_ideation_scores_FU2 = magical_ideation_scale_FU2 %>% rowMeans(na.rm=T)
magical_ideation_scale_FU2 %>% psych::alpha()
```

perceptual aberration

```{r}
WSS_survey_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(WSS_16:WSS_30) %>% psych::alpha()
wss_perceptual_aberration_score_FU2 = WSS_survey_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(WSS_16:WSS_30) %>% rowMeans(na.rm=T)
```

physical anhedonia

```{r}
physical_anhedonia_scale_FU2 = WSS_survey_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(WSS_31, WSS_33:WSS_46)

physical_anhedonia_scale_FU2 %>% psych::alpha()

wss_physical_anhedonia_score_FU2 = physical_anhedonia_scale_FU2 %>% rowMeans(na.rm=T)
```

```{r}
WSS_scores_FU2 = data.frame(ID = data_FU2$ID, wss_magical_ideation_scores_FU2, wss_perceptual_aberration_score_FU2, wss_physical_anhedonia_score_FU2)
```

SPQ next. Only No Close Friends, Constricted Affect, and Eccentric Behavior subscales of the SPQ were included in FU2. 

```{r}
SPQ_scales_FU2 = data_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("SPQ"))
```


```{r}

spq_no_close_friends_FU2 = SPQ_scales_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(SPQ_1:SPQ_3) %>% rowMeans(na.rm = T)
spq_constricted_affect_FU2 = SPQ_scales_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(SPQ_4, SPQ_5, SPQ_7) %>% rowMeans(na.rm=T)
spq_eccentric_behavior_FU2 = SPQ_scales_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(SPQ_8:SPQ_11) %>% rowMeans(na.rm=T)



SPQ_scales_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(SPQ_1:SPQ_3) %>% psych::alpha()
SPQ_scales_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(SPQ_4, SPQ_5, SPQ_7) %>% psych::alpha()
SPQ_scales_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(SPQ_8:SPQ_11) %>% psych::alpha()


SPQ_scores_FU2 = data.frame(ID = data_FU2$ID, spq_no_close_friends_FU2, spq_constricted_affect_FU2, spq_eccentric_behavior_FU2)
```

Combining all of the schizotypy scores into one data frame

```{r}
df_schizotypy_FU2 = cbind(MSS_scores_FU2, WSS_scores_FU2, SPQ_scores_FU2)

positive_FU2 = df_schizotypy_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(wss_magical_ideation_scores_FU2, wss_perceptual_aberration_score_FU2)

negative_FU2 = df_schizotypy_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(wss_physical_anhedonia_score_FU2, spq_no_close_friends_FU2, spq_constricted_affect_FU2)

disorganized_FU2 = df_schizotypy_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(MSS_scores_FU2, spq_eccentric_behavior_FU2)

schizotypy_df_organized_FU2 = cbind(ID = data_FU2$ID, positive_FU2, negative_FU2, disorganized_FU2)

```


visual

auditory
```{r}
SeSS_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(SeSS_11:SeSS_21) %>% psych::alpha()
auditory_score_FU2 = SeSS_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(SeSS_11:SeSS_21) %>% rowMeans(na.rm=T)
```


```{r}
SeSS_score_FU2 = data.frame(ID = data_FU2$ID,visual_score_FU2,auditory_score_FU2)

SeSS_score_FU2$SeSS_FU2 = SeSS_score_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(-ID) %>% rowMeans(na.rm=T)
```

Behavior Identification Form

```{r}
BIF_scores_FU2 = data_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("Q")) %>% rowMeans(na.rm = T)
BIF_FU2 = data.frame(ID = data_FU2$ID, BIF = BIF_scores_FU2)

data_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("Q")) %>% psych::alpha()
```


```{r}

score_list_FU2 = list(original_AQ_scores_FU2, new_AQ_scores_FU2, schizotypy_df_organized_FU2, SeSS_score_FU2, ASI_df_FU2, REI_score_FU2, BIF_FU2)


complete_scores_FU2 = score_list_FU2%>% reduce(full_join, by='ID')
```

Winsorize the scores to replace outliers

```{r}
winsor = function(x){
  upper = mean(x, na.rm=T) + 3 * sd(x, na.rm=T)
  lower = mean(x, na.rm=T) - 3 * sd(x, na.rm=T)
  x[x > upper] = upper
  x[x<lower] = lower
  return(x)
}

complete_scores_winsorized_FU2 = complete_scores_FU2 %>% mutate(across(original_AQ_social_anhedonia_FU2:BIF, winsor))
```

```{r}
write.csv(complete_scores_FU2, "complete scores FU2.csv")
write.csv(complete_scores_winsorized_FU2, "complete scores winsorzied FU2.csv")
```
